name: feature.knowledge-sync.nodes
description: Knowledge-sync feature node pack (WF-KB-3 / KSWF-1). One role:"action" node — `run` — that executes one scheduled knowledge-sync pass for a SyncSource through ctx.features['knowledge-sync'].runOnce: list → diff → fetch+ingest → prune, with all the ADR 0605 hardening (pre-run lease, destructive-diff refusal, Tier-2 erasure, subject-scoped prune) behind the WF-KB-4 spend gate. The node reads sourceId from ctx.config (frozen at chain expansion, RFC 0013 Path A). A tenant that disabled the feature makes the surface throw host_capability_disabled, which the node converts to a clean skip (no egress, no failed run). Recorded → replay/fork-safe; a fork never re-issues the egress. This lane replaces the retired knowledgeSyncDaemon, folding the recurring sync onto the ONE host scheduler.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Knowledge Sync: Run
nodes.description: Run one scheduled knowledge-sync pass for a SyncSource (list → diff → fetch+ingest → prune) via ctx.features['knowledge-sync'].runOnce, behind the WF-KB-4 spend gate. Reads sourceId from ctx.config (frozen at chain expansion). Output: { status:'success', ingested, pruned, unchanged, failed } on a run, or { status:'skipped', reason } when the feature is disabled / not entitled / not due (backoff) / a pass is already in flight — a skip never touches third-party egress or embedding.
